cars.generation: First-generation WC34 Autech 260RS performance-wagon road family

cars.generation: Original R130 front-wheel-drive rotary-coupe production family
cars.specification_market: Mazda Rotary Engine Press Information 2017, first-production Japan-specification appendix: printed 27/PDF15 enlarged and read; full relevant R130 block and manual gearbox line independently enlarged.
